privacy: No transcript prose, arguments, absolute paths or custom tool names are included. Stable aliases/hashes are pseudonyms, not guaranteed anonymization. Review before sharing.

payloads.definition: Text payloads observed in this transcript, excluding recognized runner envelopes; not provider tokens, wire replay or proven waste.

cost.billing_note: No subscription charge/remaining quota is inferred. API-equivalent estimates exclude non-token fees and are not invoices. OpenRouter credits remain separately denominated.

task.note: Outcome and task equivalence are user-supplied; a hashed evidence file does not prove correctness.

unavailable.tool_schema_tokens_exact: No provider per-schema token attribution. Inventory bytes/4 is a rough heuristic only.
unavailable.context_replay_ratio_tokens: Transcripts do not provide complete tokenized request bodies; cache share is not replay ratio.
unavailable.compression_saving: No controlled intervention and quality-preserving repeated trials are established.
unavailable.avoidable_cost: Repetition can be necessary; no counterfactual billing is observed.

request_snapshot_evidence.definition: Exact canonical-JSON message byte overlap with the previous supplied request; includes first request in denominator. Not tokens or waste. Valid only for one chronological conversation.

findings.action: Review identical results. Reuse a prior read only when target, range and version are unchanged. Never skip required tests or freshness checks.
